stem: What happens next in this passage after “The town worked with farmers to reduce runoff and planted grasses near the shore.”?
options: Students learned that clear water is not automatically safe.
A clear bottle stood on the teacher's desk.
The lake did not become clear in one season.
A boy brought a cactus that had become soft.
